name: k-budget-packing
question: At a fixed `## Knowledge` inject budget, does the packing strategy -- not retrieval, not the budget number -- decide whether a question's evidence reaches the reader?

arms.s1-greedy-whole: the shipped control (knowledge.knowledge_section): whole entries in rank order, stop at the first overflow, byte-slice only a lone oversized first entry
arms.s2-per-entry-cap: cap every entry at budget // 3, keep walking the rank order with what the caps left over
arms.s3-head-then-fill: guarantee the top entries a 256 B head each, then spend the remainder deepening them from the top down
arms.s4-rank-proportional: split the budget by a 1/(rank+1) weight over the top 8 hits, then sweep unspent slack back down the ranks

budget_note: 2048/8192/32768 are roster.KNOWLEDGE_SIZES small/medium/large verbatim (#52); 4096 is a mid point the suite does not currently offer, so the run also reads on whether the T-shirt values are set right.
dataset: LongMemEval_S cleaned (MIT, xiaowu0162), cached outside the repo at ~/.cache/k-next-longmemeval/
subset: ../k-next-embeddings/fixtures/k6/subset.json (50 question ids, stratified, seed 42) -- reused, not resampled, so coverage here subtracts cleanly from K6's hit@k

mechanical.shape: one k7e store + one embedded search per question; all 16 strategy x budget packs come off that single retrieval result
mechanical.metric: full evidence coverage -- every `has_answer: true` turn's text present in the packed prompt (normalized substring); no LLM

agy.shape: n-small direction check: multi-session + temporal-reasoning (25 questions) x control vs the two leading challengers x 2048/8192 = 150 calls
agy.reader: Antigravity (agy) --model gemini-3.6-flash-low via the verified sh -c stdin wrapper
agy.metric: contains_answer against the dataset's own answer field, plus answer token recall

predictions.claim: At 2048, s1-greedy-whole packs a median of 1 entry (the K6 observation, reproduced)
At 2048 and 8192, at least one challenger beats s1-greedy-whole on full coverage for multi-session and temporal-reasoning
No challenger lowers full coverage on the single-session types at any budget
At 32768 every strategy converges -- SEARCH_LIMIT (8), not bytes, becomes the binding constraint

org.note: Not org/posthoc-class -- no r4t roster, no member, no dispatch process. The strategies live in packing.py as pure functions over (entries, budget) so a winner ports into knowledge.knowledge_section unchanged; the driver imports SEARCH_LIMIT and _entry_snippet from apps/r4t/knowledge.py, and the LLM arm imports KNOWLEDGE_HEADER/KNOWLEDGE_FRAMING, so no arm can drift from what ships. Same bespoke-driver precedent as k0-knowledge-inject, k-next-embeddings, k4e-poisoning and k-age-presentation.
